results.title: Crowdstrike to acquire Zscaler in $44B deal that would create a cybersecurity giant - ABC News
results.snippet: Shares of CrowdStrike tumbled more than 7% before the opening bell Monday. Shares of Zscaler rose 20%. Existing CrowdStrike shareholders will own about 84.1% of the combined company, while existing Zscaler shareholders will hold the remaining 15.9%. CrowdStrike and Zscaler were already working together in a partnership that included 2,000 shared customers. The deal would expand the combined company's market by more than $185 billion by 2029. [...] Crowdstrike's focus has been on so-called endpoint security, with services to protect laptops, mobile devices and desktop computers. Santa Clara, California-based Zscaler, meanwhile, specializes in cloud-based network protection. Zscaler shareholders will get 1.135 shares of Crowdstrike for each Zscaler share they own, under the deal's terms, which represent a 34% premium to Zscaler's closing price on Friday.
